verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair question for a work-tracking SaaS like Jira, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a mobile app, iOS/Android clients, or parity with desktop features. The board/list/timeline views, integrations and APIs cited are not evidenced on mobile and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
